scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/api dev & bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/validators build && bun run --cwd packages/shared build && bun run --cwd apps/api prisma:generate && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/web lint && bun run --cwd apps/api lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
